    target "3..5 g/kg/day (higher on squat/deadlift days, lower on deload)"
    timing "30..60 g carb pre-lift; 30..60 g carb with protein post-lift"

    target "0.8..1.2 g/kg/day"
    quality "emphasize mono/polyunsaturated fats; include omega-3s (2..3 servings fatty fish/week or 1..2 g EPA+DHA)"
  HYDRATION_COOLING:
    baseline "35..45 ml/kg/day fluids; add 500..750 ml per training hour"
    electrolytes "add 300..500 mg sodium per hour training if sweating; include potassium and magnesium"
    pre_cool "consume 300..500 ml cold fluid 30 min pre; consider ice slurry if tolerated"
    intra "150..250 ml every 10..15 min; use cool drinks"
    post "replete 1.5x body mass lost via sweat within 4h; include sodium"
  BONE_HEALTH_MICROS:
    calcium "1200 mg/day from food first (dairy/fortified or tofu with calcium sulfate); supplement to fill gaps"

    vitamin_K "consume leafy greens; consider K2 MK-7 90..180 mcg/day if intake low"
    magnesium "320..400 mg/day (glycinate/citrate forms); supports sleep and hot flash management"
    phosphorus "adequate via protein foods; aim for Ca:P ~1:1"

    spicy_foods "reduce near training if triggering vasomotor symptoms"
